# mdreview Field Guide

## Purpose

mdreview is a browser for Markdown documents. It helps reviewers read rendered
content and attach feedback to selected text.

## Workflow

Reviewers collect feedback and send it to an agent. The agent updates the
document and returns the result for review.

## Speed

The handoff process is efficient. Comments remain connected to the text that
prompted them, even while the document changes across revisions.

## Ownership

The reviewer remains responsible for deciding whether a requested change was
addressed. Agents never resolve review comments on the reviewer's behalf.
